name: Hamming Radius / Characteristic-p Yang Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, Hamming radius is $\lceil n/2\rceil$, while $\mathrm Y_p$ is $1$ for every prime $p$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For $\mathcal S_n$, $\mathrm Y_p=n-1$ for every prime $p$, while Hamming radius is $1$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions, uniformly in the fixed characteristic $p$.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Hamming Radius and Characteristic-p Yang Dimension of Trivial Concepts and Singletons.
